title: Victorian Greens seek urgent injunction over how-to-vote cards mimicking party’s branding but preferencing it last
summary_full: Exclusive: Independent candidate Tosh-Jake Finnigan’s cards instruct people to vote in a way that would benefit Liberal partyGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastThe Victorian Greens are seeking an urgent injunction from the supreme court to stop an independent candidate distributing how-to-vote cards that allegedly mimic the party’s branding and urge people to preference it last.As prepoll opened on Wednesday morning, Tosh-Jake Finnigan’s campaign team handed out how-to-vote cards that used the minor party’s colour scheme, font and triangle logo with the banner “Vote 1 Green Values”.
